Two findings applied in part: /ledger/55 (1834) was narrowed to the non-Assam cells instead of dropped, because it is the only event covering the Manipur, Arunachal and Nagaland cells; /ledger/21 (1800) was not renamed hyderabad-state because the Ceded Districts cover 1 of its 179 cells, so the 1800 cession is a separate event. indian-rebels-of-1857 was not touched (verdict thin) and no longer matches this ledger place by place; it needs the gap-filler (see gaps).
